UnitStatement: External tools are configured as gitignored external dependencies rather than vendored copies.
edgequake-pdf2md is a pipeline tool used in Step 0 of the DOMAIN pipeline.
synalinks is the preferred ad hoc utility for human-directed entity extraction when bridging DOMAIN knowledge into PROJECT or SOFTWARE contexts.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk provides an optional queryable long-term knowledge layer.
zingg remains available for fuzzy entity resolution workflows.

PIPELINE_DESIGN.md is authoritative for the entity type registry, ID namespace rules, canonical CSV schemas, confidence levels, validation criteria, execution model, and domain-specific tool configuration.
chirality-domain-test is a structured, auditable agent framework for domain knowledge curation.
chirality-domain-test decomposes handbooks into Categories and Knowledge Types and produces Knowledge Artifacts.
chirality-domain-test builds and audits a structural hypergraph of workspace organization.
Native PDF2MD rasterizes pages via pymupdf and dispatches per-page Type 2 agents for multimodal vision conversion.
Native PDF2MD post-processes output with 10-rule cleanup and header/footer stripping before assembling one Markdown file.
Native PDF2MD is resumable and batch-parallel.
edgequake-pdf2md rasterizes PDF pages to images and sends them to VLMs for structure-preserving conversion.
edgequake-pdf2md is a Rust CLI and library superseded by native PDF2MD for Step 0 but retained as an alternative.
zingg learns blocking and similarity models from small labeled training sets via active learning.
zingg clusters records that refer to the same real-world entity and runs on Apache Spark.
synalinks defines entity types as DataModel classes and extracts structured entities through a Generator with schema-constrained output.
synalinks emits deterministic GB.v1.0 extraction CSVs.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk is a Python client for Synalinks Memory's hosted knowledge API.
Synalinks Memory is an optional query layer over extracted entities and is derived from extraction outputs, not canonical.
pdftotext is used for deterministic extraction of embedded title-block text.
pdftotext supports drawing-number verification and system-name candidate harvesting from PDF text layers.
Pillow supports ad hoc operator-side image cropping and contact-sheet generation during drawing extraction QA and workflow prototyping.
chirality-domain-test agents produce structural hypergraph CSVs for Categories, Knowledge Types, Artifacts, Ledger bindings, Objectives, and their n-ary relationships.
TASK+domain-documents produces Reference.md, Standard.md, Procedure.md, and Guidance.md Knowledge Artifacts per Knowledge Type.
TASK+semantic-matrix-build produces _SEMANTIC.md as a conceptual coordinate system per Knowledge Type.
TASK+lens-register produces _SEMANTIC_LENSING.md as an enrichment register identifying gaps and conflicts.
PDF2MD outputs clean structured Markdown from PDF sources while preserving tables, headings, lists, formulas, and reading order.
PDF2MD writes per-page .md files in a work directory as resumable intermediate artifacts.
PDF2MD writes manifest.json with page metadata including page count, DPI, and rendering timestamp.
PDF2MD integrates header/footer removal via clean_pdf2md_output.py.
zingg output augments input records with z_cluster, z_minScore, and z_maxScore.
zingg produces a trained blocking model using hash functions to reduce comparison space.
zingg produces a trained similarity model that scores record pairs.
synalinks outputs GB.v1.0 nodes.csv for typed EXTRACTED_ENTITY nodes with EXT-{EntitySubtype}-{blake2b[:12]} IDs.
synalinks outputs GB.v1.0 edges.csv for typed relationships between extracted entities.
synalinks defines entity types inline in extraction scripts as synalinks.DataModel classes per project.
synalinks constrains confidence levels to HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW according to PIPELINE_DESIGN.md section 2.1.
synalinks uses deterministic blake2b identity fingerprinting so the same identity fields produce the same ID.
synalinks writes extraction metadata JSON with source document, timestamp, configuration, and entity/relationship counts.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk returns query results over uploaded extraction data via Synalinks Memory's hosted API.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk is not a canonical data store because it is derived from extraction outputs.
The DOMAIN pipeline starts from source documents in _Sources, typically handbooks and reference PDFs.
PDF2MD agent runs as Step 0 of the DOMAIN pipeline.
Step 0 produces readable Markdown source documents with preserved text, tables, and structure.
DOMAIN_DECOMP runs at Step 1 after Markdown source documents are available.
PREPARATION runs at Step 2 after DOMAIN_DECOMP.
TASK+domain-documents runs at Step 3 and produces Knowledge Artifacts per Knowledge Type.
DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH runs at Step 4 after domain-document production.
AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE runs at Step 5 after DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH.
The DOMAIN pipeline is a single linear path from source documents through an audited structural hypergraph.
Step 0 PDF2MD depends on PDF source documents in _Sources.
Step 1 DOMAIN_DECOMP depends on human input and Markdown sources from Step 0.
Step 2 PREPARATION depends on the decomposition.
Step 3 TASK+domain-documents depends on preparation and Markdown sources.
Step 4 DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH depends on PREPARATION and reads folder structure.
Step 5 AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE depends on DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH.
Native PDF2MD uses pymupdf for rasterization and Claude Code's multimodal vision for per-page conversion.
Native PDF2MD replaces edgequake-pdf2md for Step 0.
The DOMAIN pipeline produces a knowledge layer of normative rules, trade-off guidance, step-by-step procedures, and verification criteria.
The human bridges DOMAIN knowledge to PROJECT or SOFTWARE contexts through validation and decision-making.
DOMAIN-to-PROJECT or DOMAIN-to-SOFTWARE bridging is not a pipeline stage.
Agents may assist bridging by extracting data, cross-referencing KTY standards, and building case-specific relationship maps.
The human directs what agents extract, decides what extracted data means, and validates whether mappings are correct.
For project-task entity data, the human can use extraction utilities.
synalinks extracts typed entities from a human-selected document using DataModel classes and a Generator for schema-constrained structured output.
synalinks produces GB.v1.0 compliant CSVs with deterministic blake2b IDs.
Deterministic identity fingerprinting handles the common entity-resolution case without a separate Spark-based resolution step.
zingg is a legacy utility for resolving entity identity across multiple extraction outputs using ML-based matching on Apache Spark.
zingg remains documented for fuzzy cross-document matching at scale when deterministic identity fingerprinting is insufficient.
Entity-extraction utilities produce ad hoc graphs scoped to human-selected documents.
Ad hoc graphs are validated by the human before use and are not pipeline stages that run automatically.
DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH reads workspace folder structure and metadata stubs named _CONTEXT.md and _REFERENCES.md.
DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH produces the structural hypergraph as the terminal data artifact of the DOMAIN pipeline.
AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE reads the structural hypergraph and validates structural integrity, referential integrity, and completeness.
ORCHESTRATOR coordinates the pipeline and invokes the PDF2MD agent at Step 0 and sub-agents at Steps 1 through 7.
ORCHESTRATOR may assist the human with ad hoc entity extraction work when directed.
PDF2MD orchestrates PDF-to-Markdown conversion at Step 0.
PDF2MD rasterizes PDF pages to PNGs using tools/pdf2md/rasterize_pdf.py.
PDF2MD dispatches PDF2MD_PAGE sub-agents in configurable batches for multimodal vision conversion.
PDF2MD runs tools/pdf2md/postprocess_page.py for 10-rule cleanup.
PDF2MD runs tools/reporting/clean_pdf2md_output.py for header/footer stripping.
PDF2MD assembles final Markdown via tools/pdf2md/assemble_markdown.py.
DRAWING_EXTRACT orchestrates drawing-type-aware structured extraction from engineering drawing PDFs.
DRAWING_EXTRACT uses type-agnostic core phases for rasterization, crop preparation, dispatch, schema validation, assembly, and reporting.
DRAWING_EXTRACT uses target-specific hooks for crop geometry, sanitization rules, assembly columns, QA metrics, and merge keys.
PFD drawing extraction implements top_equipment_header_basic and top_equipment_header_detailed targets.
P_AND_ID, ISOMETRIC, and GA drawing extraction targets are registered as stubs that fail fast at pre-flight.
DRAWING_EXTRACT per-page artifacts use target-aware paths with self-describing YAML frontmatter for resume-safety validation.
prepare_header_crops.py supplies the drawing-type crop-spec registry in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
validate_resume_stub_metadata.py performs resume-safety validation in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
report_stub_counts.py and sanitize_equipment_stubs.py support target-aware QA in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
validate_detailed_schema.py checks schema consistency in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
assemble_equipment_csv.py and assemble_equipment_markdown.py assemble target-driven columns in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
flag_duplicate_equipment_csv.py and dedupe_equipment_csv.py support duplicate management in the v2 DRAWING_EXTRACT tool chain.
merge_equipment_detailed.py and flag_merge_conflicts.py support PFD-equipment-repertoire-scoped deterministic merge.
Project-fallback tools remain available for site-specific drawing extraction workflows.
Synalinks is the preferred extraction path for ad hoc entity extraction.
Zingg is optional for fuzzy cross-document matching when deterministic identity fingerprinting is insufficient.
Synalinks and zingg documentation covers interfaces, data contracts, and entity resolution patterns for human-directed PROJECT or SOFTWARE extraction work.
Synalinks-to-zingg flattening uses CSV or Parquet format.
When fuzzy resolution is needed across multiple extraction outputs, extracted entities are flattened to flat records for zingg.
Synalinks-to-zingg flattening uses one row per extracted entity.
Synalinks-to-zingg flattening includes entity_id, entity_type, label, identity field columns, source_kty, and source_doc columns.
zingg FieldDefinition maps each flattened column to a domain-appropriate match type such as FUZZY, EXACT, or TEXT.
zingg output uses CSV or Parquet format.
zingg output contains the same records as input augmented with z_cluster, z_minScore, and z_maxScore.
z_cluster is an integer cluster ID for entities resolved as the same real-world entity.
z_minScore is the lowest match confidence within a cluster.
z_maxScore is the highest match confidence within a cluster.
Entity resolution is divided between tools based on what each tool does best.
zingg handles cross-document entity identity through structured record matching with fuzzy fields.
zingg scales cross-document entity identity resolution via a blocking model.
A trained zingg model is deterministic, so the same inputs produce the same clusters.
zingg handles typos, abbreviations, and naming variations in cross-document entity identity resolution.
LLM-assisted entity-to-knowledge correspondence requires reading production documents and understanding domain semantics.
Entity-to-knowledge correspondence cannot be reduced to field-level similarity because it requires contextual reasoning about whether an extracted entity refers to a KTY-covered concept.
Zingg requires labeled match and no-match training pairs.
Exact-match entity pairs with identical identity fingerprints serve as positive examples.
Entity pairs with different entity types serve as negative examples.
zingg's findTrainingData phase selects candidate pairs for LLM-assisted labeling.
The LLM evaluates zingg candidate pairs using relevant KTY production documents and provides match or no-match labels.
Active learning prioritizes the most informative uncertain pairs to minimize LLM evaluations.
Once trained, zingg's model is deterministic and scalable.
The LLM's judgment is used for zingg training, not for every entity pair at inference time.
Native PDF2MD requires installing pymupdf with pip install pymupdf.
Native PDF2MD does not require a VLM API key because it uses Claude Code's built-in multimodal vision.
Native PDF2MD can be invoked with --agent PDF2MD or spawned by ORCHESTRATOR.
Drawing extraction support utilities require installing pillow.
Optional PDF title-block verification requires pdftotext.
pdftotext is typically provided by Poppler packages such as poppler-utils.
edgequake-pdf2md can be installed with cargo install edgequake-pdf2md.
edgequake-pdf2md requires a VLM API key set as an environment variable.
zingg requires Apache Spark.
synalinks is installed by running uv sync from the synalinks directory.
synalinks extraction requires an LLM API key such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude models via LiteLLM.
Synalinks extraction scripts run from the workspace directory with uv run --project ../../synalinks python run_synalinks_extraction.py.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk is installed by running uv sync from the synalinks-memory-python-sdk directory.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk requires SYNALINKS_API_KEY for the hosted Memory API.
synalinks-memory-python-sdk supports both list() and the explicit alias list_predicates().
Tool directories for edgequake-pdf2md, zingg, synalinks, and synalinks-memory-python-sdk are gitignored and untracked if present locally.
